entities.name: Tigecycline
observations: SMILES identifies tigecycline; reported profile: MW 585.61 g/mol, TPSA 208.17 Å², 7 H-bond donors, 12 acceptors, LogP 0.01.
High molecular weight and polarity support predicted poor passive blood-brain barrier penetration; this is a structure-based inference, not direct experimental evidence.
